entries.name: The Lands Outside
entries.content:
The lands outside is the name of the world, made up of one large continent, and a scattering of islands and atolls in the oceans.
The lands outside is the home to 5 kingdoms and a scattering of nomadic tribes
Of the kingdoms there is:
The Terre kingdom in the center
The Étoile kingdom to the north
The Caelus kingdom to the east
The Mar kingdom to the south
And The Souterraine kingdom to the west

entries.name: Terre kingdom
entries.content:
The Terre kingdom: home to the family of Terra and located at the center of the continent. The Terre kingdom is the most powerful kingdom, with a strong military force and more than enough food to feed their people without importing
Relations: The Terre kingdom is a peace keeper among the kingdoms, however their relations with the Caelus and Souterrain kingdoms are strained at best, having the best relations with the Étoile kingdom and having a lukewarm relationship with the Mar kingdom.
Royal family: the Terra's are the royal family of the Terre kingdom, the Terra family consists of Johana Terra, the queen; Quentin Terra, the king; and Larissa Terra, the only child and crown princess of Terre

entries.name: Étoile kingdom
entries.content:
The Étoile kingdom: home to the family of Stellaris and located to the north of the Terre kingdom. The Étoile kingdom boasts powerful magicians and amazing textiles, having just enough food to feed their people, though they do import during the coldest season.
Relations: the Étoile kingdom is a seculeded and powerful kingdom, all but the Terre kingdom fear bringing their rage to their doorstep, The Étoile kingdom only has close relations with the Terre kingdom, with them keeping minimum contact with the Caelus kingdom to import foods during the winter.
Royal family: The Stellaris are the family of the Étoile kingdom, consisting of Loral Stellaris, the queen; Aaron Stellaris, the king; and three children that haven't been shown to anybody but the king and queen of Terre.

entries.name: Caelus kingdom
entries.content:
The Caelus kingdom: home to the family of Nimbus and is located to the east of the Terre kingdom. The Caelus kingdom prides itself on its abundance of crops and bird tamers, having the majority of their food exported and still able to feed their people, and having a reputation as info gatherers.
Relations: The Caelus kingdom prefers to remian neutral with all but the Terre kingdom, who they are not fond of due to the Terre enforcing them to reduce their information gathering operations. the Caelus often trade with the Étoile kingdom, giving food for textiles.
Royal family: The Nimbus family hasn't revealed themselves in years, prefering to remain in their kingdom and out of prying eyes.

entries.name: Mar kingdom
entries.content:
The Mar kingdom: home to the family of Aqua, located to the south of the Terre kingdom. The Mar kingdom is the home of the best sailers and fisherman in the world, most sailers outside of The Mar kingdom lived there at somepoint in time.
Relations: as a trading kingdom the Mar kingdom prefers to keep relations at least amicable with all the kingdoms, with them being the only ones to trade with the Souterrain kingdom, they have an especially close relationship.
Royal family: the Aqua family is the royal family of the Mar kingdom, consisting of Delmar Aqua, the king; Lucille Aqua, the queen, and 2 children that have yet to be shown to the public.

entries.name: souterraine kingdom
entries.content:
The Souterraine kingdom: home of the Tenebris family, located to the west of the Terre kingdom. The Souterraine kingdom located almost entirely underground boasts thr great miners and most amazing smiths in all the kingdoms.
Relations: the Souterraine kingdom interacts almost exclusively with the Mar kingdom, and occasionally with the Étoile kingdom begrudgingly as the Stellaris family teaches a few Souterraine people magic to create and sustain their subterranean lights. They hate the Terre kingdom but remain neutral so as not to anger the Étoile kingdom.
Royal family: the Tenebris family has always remained hidden in Shadows, and have only revealed themselves once before, a century ago.

entries.name: Magic
entries.content: Magic is largely uncommon among all kingdoms except the Étoile kingdom, where near every citizen has atleast a little talent for magic.

entries.name: Taming
entries.content:
Taming is an ability that few outside of those in the Caelus kingdom are capable of.
Taming is an understanding of animals that goes beyond natural, in some cases one might simply know if an animal is hungry, however in the most powerful cases a person could convince a herd of animals to do near anything with a single word, or even speak with and understand animals.
